name: Australian National Defence Strategy & Defence Strategic Review (2020)
description: Official 2020 edition of Australian National Defence Strategy & Defence Strategic Review (Australian National Defence Strategy & Defence Strategic Review (2020)), published by Department of Defence (Australia) (defence.gov.au).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Department of Defence (Australia) (defence.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
